normativeScope: expectedCandidates is normative for lookup ORDER only: a conformant renderer must consult catalogs in this relative order and stop at the first declared candidate. It is not a required public API shape. A binding may expose the full ordered list including undeclared keys, or only the subset the document declares; both are conformant as long as expectedCatalog is what resolution selects.

cases.name: canonical requested tag selects its own catalog
underscores and non-canonical case resolve to the authored catalog
an ICU numeric region tag selects the numeric-region catalog
Unicode extension subtags are not part of catalog identity
an en-US-POSIX identifier reduces to the base language
a script subtag reduces to the base language, never to language plus region
an undeclared region falls through to the fallback catalog
an unusable requested locale falls through to the fallback catalog
an ICU keyword identifier denotes the locale before the keyword
a POSIX charset suffix denotes the locale before the suffix
an ICU region override denotes the overridden locale
a Java Locale.toString extension marker denotes the locale before the marker
a malformed trailing subtag still reaches the base-language catalog
